Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.

2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.141 of 2023, under Section 498A, 323, 504,
304B IPC & Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Kotwali Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar.
3. In terms of the FIR it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was married to the applicant around five years ago and was blessed with a child who is aged about two years.

sentences.text: entire matrimonial family used to harass her and on 16.06.2023, the entire matrimonial family had killed the daughter.

The postmortem report on record records the cause of death as ante mortem strangulation, however, counsel for the applicant argues that as the hyoid bone was found to be not fractured, prima-facie, the reasoning recorded in the postmortem is not corroborated in terms of the report itself.

He further argues that the co-accused have been enlarged on bail vide separate orders which are on record as Annexure - 6, however, the applicant does not claim parity with them as he is the husband.
4.
Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the postmortem report and the inconsistencies as highlighted by counsel for the applicant coupled with the fact that there is no specific allegation against the applicant, who is the husband, of having harassed the victim either physically or mentally in relation to demand of dowry soon before her death and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 18.06.2023 and the trial has not even started, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Pawan Kumar be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 10.7.2024 nishant  Pawan Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru.
